name: Mad Mage Tower
description: Crane-stacking tower builder (Tower Bloxx / Stack). A floor swings on a crane; tap to drop it onto the tower. Overhang is sliced off; a perfect drop keeps full width + combo. Each floor: faster crane, narrower margin. Score per floor, camera rises, claymation fantasy floors. Menu START screen + game-over endcard with CTA. Procedural clay visuals by default; swaps to generated sprites when present in assets/.
